text_block_list.text:
"Drawn in by the cheerful atmosphere, I 
stopped by the Christmas market for a bit. 
And what I saw there was—"
choice_data_list: Journey!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a coincidence. Fufu... You seem 
in quite high spirits. Did you find 
something nice while shopping?
choice_data_list: No, just walking around is fun enough.
No, just walking around like this is fun.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand. The town is lovely 
around Christmas, isn't it? Adults and 
children alike, everyone looks so happy 
together.
choice_data_list: Is Journey out shopping?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It was just on a whim for me, too. I 
simply felt that it might be fun.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I also wanted to see the 
illuminations.
choice_data_list: It really is beautiful, isn't it?
It really is beautiful, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Just like stars twinkling in the 
night sky.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that travelers in ancient times 
used lights like those as guides to decide 
which path to take.
choice_data_list: Huh... I see.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was destiny that both of us 
were invited here.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Trainer. To celebrate this 
wonderful encounter of ours, how about we 
exchange presents?"
choice_data_list: A present exchange?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As for the rules... let's see. Simply 
choose one gift around here that you think 
is 'befitting' for the other person and 
present it. Simple, right?
choice_data_list: Sounds fun, let's do it!
Sounds like fun, let's do it!

text_block_list.text:
Spurred by Dream Journey's delightful 
suggestion, I inadvertently jump at the 
offer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Well then, once we grasp the 
pinnacle, let us meet again.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: In one hour, right here.

Gazing at the dazzling shops, I look for 
something that would suit Dream Journey.
choice_data_list:
(What kind of things does Journey like, I 
wonder?)
(I wonder what Journey likes?)

text_block_list.text:
I recalled how often she used to drink 
black tea... She was quite particular 
about it... always selecting tea leaves to 
match the season and her mood.
choice_data_list:
(But... I'd rather get something that 
won't just disappear.)

text_block_list.text:
If that's the case... I thought items for 
"traveling" would be best after all.

"Carry-on cases, passport holders, eye 
masks, earplugs, cameras, blankets... I 
browse through anything and everything 
related to 'travel'."
choice_data_list: (Hmm, I'm not really getting it...)

text_block_list.text:
As proof of the bond forged from traveling 
together this far, and as a vow to keep 
walking alongside each other from here 
on... I wanted to give a gift full of 
meaning.

Even when she hesitates and comes to a 
halt, I want to be the beacon that 
illuminates her journey.

"With a vow to walk together, all the way 
to the 'end of our journey'—"

"Just then, a dazzling gold suddenly 
flashed into my field of vision."
—An exquisitely crafted gold compass.
choice_data_list: This is it...!

text_block_list.text:
Upon heading to the meeting spot, Dream 
Journey was already there.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My, that look on your face... It seems you 
found something to your liking.
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... My, my. I'm very much looking 
forward to it.

The present Dream Journey took out... was 
remarkably similar in both size and 
wrapping to the one I had prepared.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Shall we open them at the same time, then?

Upon opening the box— a familiar gold 
shimmered inside.

"It's a gold-crafted compass, chosen to 
hold my own vow."

—My heart beats rapidly. I couldn't help 
but cry out.
choice_data_list: This is the exact same one I picked out!
This is the exact same one I picked out!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Matching markers, I see.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps... no matter where one is, it 
serves as a beacon—never letting them lose 
their way.
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... No. I was just deeply moved by a 
miracle that seemed almost arranged.

Dream Journey smiled gently, as if she had 
anticipated everything.

A chill ran down my spine. Was this result 
truly just a miracle?
Or could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. You know, I am very 
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"No matter where you go, you never change. 
...That is precisely why I can entrust 
this signpost to you."

Even this wavering in my heart must be 
completely seen through by those eyes.

With a strange sense of fulfillment in my 
heart, I faced her.
choice_data_list: Thank you for the miracle... Journey
I'll treasure it—this compass.
The present exchange was so exciting!

The present exchange was so exciting, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.text:
With a strange sense of fulfillment in my 
heart, I faced her.
choice_data_list: Thank you for the miracle... Journey
I'll treasure it—this compass.
The present exchange was so exciting!

The present exchange was so exciting, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.text:
She narrowed her eyes with joy, her smile 
growing even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I should be the one thanking you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It shines with exceptional brilliance. 
This "Covenant of the Edge"—exchanged with 
you.

Even if I can't understand everything 
about her... I still want to be the 
partner who journeys alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And... no matter the circumstance, 
you must never lose sight of it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The destination you believe in. The path 
you must take. No matter what 
happens—never let it go.

The game she suggested made my heart truly 
race with pure excitement.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yes, truly fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Now that's a companion worthy of walking 
beside me.
